_meta.note: Team ceiling = team hours / (team hours - hours freed). Smaller team keeps half-FTE steps per role. Pods group every task by value stream (keyword rules on the task statement, then the role default).

teams.name: HR
teams.north_star: Share of open roles filled with a hire who is productive and still here after 90 days
value_streams: absence to return (verzuim, Wet verbetering poortwachter)
teams.ceiling_explained: The team spends 31% of its 20,800 hours on human tasks that stay at today's speed. With the models' median speedups it gets 1.4x faster (6,399 hours, 4.0 FTE a year). The hard limit is 3.3x: approval gates and handoffs inside the AI tasks already sit in the models' speedups, so this is the ceiling before the work itself is redesigned.

ambitious.label: Same team, more ambitious work (Jevons)
ambitious.text: Keep all 13 people. The 6,399 hours a year that come back (4.0 FTE, EUR 445,132 of loaded cost) go to work that was never done properly, moving the North Star: share of open roles filled with a hire who is productive and still here after 90 days.

by_role.title: HR Administrator
by_role.ambitious_version: Every employee, and every flex worker who stays through the season, has a complete file before day one. Every mandatory certificate is valid. Every absence file shows the poortwachter dates. A manager on a night shift in Venlo gets a cited answer during the shift. The two administrators spend the week on the exceptions, the CAO edge cases, and on tightening rules the works council has agreed.

by_role.title: Recruiter (talent acquisition)
by_role.ambitious_version: The two recruiters keep Rotterdam, Tilburg, and Venlo staffed to a rolling plan. Matching, status messages, and standard job facts run on approved rules with a human gate. Their own week goes to hard shifts, to managers whose hires do not stay, and to proof of which sources produce people who are productive and still here after 90 days.

by_role.title: Learning and Development Specialist
by_role.ambitious_version: L&D becomes the way Noordhaven raises the share of open roles filled by someone who is productive and still here after 90 days. Every forklift, VCA and food-safety certificate is seated before it expires, including flex workers in the busy months. Every training euro is tied to a completion and, where it matters, to that 90-day outcome. Supervisor vacancies are held long enough for someone grown from the floor to be ready. The two specialists spend their time on the cohorts, the works council and the exceptions the sites will not bend.

by_role.title: HR Business Partner
by_role.ambitious_version: Run a joined hire-to-day-90 improvement programme across Rotterdam, Tilburg and Venlo. Give shift employees reliable policy help, managers practical coaching, and each site a measured plan for onboarding, skills coverage and retention. Use the released capacity to improve the share of open roles filled by people who become productive and remain after 90 days, while tracking absence, manager satisfaction and fair treatment.

by_role.title: People Analytics and HRIS Analyst
by_role.ambitious_version: The analyst runs one governed people-data layer that HR, finance and the works council can all trace to a definition. Every month, each site sees the North Star (a hire who is productive and still here at day 90), the input metrics, the absence duration classes, the flex hours and the certificate gaps, from the same AFAS, Recruitee, Studytube and agency figures, with fails shown rather than smoothed. The analyst's own year goes to the questions that change a vacancy, a roster or a return-to-work path, and to the cases the rules miss: a CAO reclassification, a Venlo night shift, a cohort of agency workers near a contract limit.

by_role.title: Payroll Specialist
by_role.ambitious_version: Pay for the shift population is under weekly control and the monthly run is a confirmation. Starters are payable on day one at the contracted scale, leave and sick pay follow the CAO without a side workbook, and the controller can tie the journal to a dataset People Analytics already refreshes. The specialist spends the freed time on the rules that still break: allowances, partial return from illness, attachments of earnings and final settlements. Own-staff pay and agency labour cost are visible in one place while the week can still be changed. A correct first payslip and quiet pay through day 90 is this role's contribution to the HR north star, and to a lower absence argument that started as a pay error.

by_role.title: Compensation and Benefits Specialist
by_role.ambitious_version: Noordhaven runs one functiehuis for both CAOs. Every job has a current profile, a grade, a scale and the certificates Studytube expects. A manager sees the allowed step before promising it. Finance and the OR see the same labour-cost picture, with flex shown separately. The specialist spends the year on CAO changes, new warehouse work, disputes, and on whether pay policy shows up in 90-day retention, absence and offer acceptance.

by_role.title: HR Director
by_role.ambitious_version: Noordhaven runs a rolling 13-week people plan per site that ties volume, absence, certificates and the vacancy pipeline together, and prices permanent staff against flex at pay parity. The director spends the freed time on the patterns that move the north star: managers whose new hires fail inside 90 days, shifts where verzuim and turnover cluster, and the works-council and CAO choices that decide whether flex stays a seasonal buffer. Policy answers, grades and forecast scenarios arrive as checked drafts with a named owner. The director's signature is the control.

smaller.label: Smaller team, same output
smaller.text: The same output needs 9.0 FTE of work. Kept in half-FTE steps per role that is 10.5 FTE instead of 13, through natural turnover rather than dismissals. One-person roles keep at least half an FTE and need cover for holidays and absence.

pods.label: Polyvalent pods per value stream
pods.text: Instead of functional roles, one small pod owns each value stream end to end and covers its tasks across today's roles; each person takes the adjacent tasks that the models' reach lines point to.

pods.value_stream: absence to return (verzuim, Wet verbetering poortwachter)

teams.name: Finance
teams.north_star: Days to close the month with a forecast the business trusts
teams.ceiling_explained: The team spends 27% of its 16,000 hours on human tasks that stay at today's speed. With the models' median speedups it gets 1.6x faster (6,274 hours, 3.9 FTE a year). The hard limit is 3.7x: approval gates and handoffs inside the AI tasks already sit in the models' speedups, so this is the ceiling before the work itself is redesigned.

ambitious.label: Same team, more ambitious work (Jevons)
ambitious.text: Keep all 10 people. The 6,274 hours a year that come back (3.9 FTE, EUR 418,877 of loaded cost) go to work that was never done properly, moving the North Star: days to close the month with a forecast the business trusts.

by_role.title: Bookkeeper (accounts payable and receivable)
by_role.ambitious_version: Run a daily transaction-control process across Rotterdam, Tilburg and Venlo that keeps approved invoices moving, balances reconciled and cash-status exceptions assigned before month end. Measure its contribution to close days, forecast accuracy, DSO, untouched invoice processing and audit adjustments. Start with deterministic rules, add document interpretation where it proves useful, and preserve independent financial approvals. Use approved agency contracts and hours for invoice checks, with HR or payroll resolving CAO interpretation. Involve the OR where process redesign or monitoring triggers its rights; assess EU AI Act obligations for the actual use, especially if scope expands into worker evaluation or management.

by_role.title: FP&A Analyst
by_role.ambitious_version: Run a weekly financial outlook that connects reconciled actuals, staffing costs, available operating volumes and project commitments. Show management emerging pressure, credible options and uncertainty before month-end, then measure forecast accuracy and realised project benefits. Pilot each workflow against current results and track days to close, preparation time, reviewer corrections and audit adjustments. Use aggregate workforce data for financial planning; any expansion into individual employment decisions requires a separate assessment of AVG/GDPR, applicable EU AI Act obligations and works council rights.

by_role.title: Accountant
by_role.ambitious_version: Run a continuously substantiated ledger across Rotterdam, Tilburg and Venlo, with recurring reconciliations checked during the month and unresolved items assigned before close. Give the Controller and FP&A team timely, traceable actuals and explanations so the forecast rests on dependable numbers. Judge success by fewer close days and audit adjustments, alongside better forecast accuracy; agree responsibilities with adjacent roles and preserve independent preparation, approval and payment controls.

by_role.title: Credit and Collections Officer
by_role.ambitious_version: Run order-to-cash credit end to end: credit limits at onboarding, risk monitoring on every customer, same-day cash application, and a dispute feedback loop that cuts billing errors at the source, bringing DSO down and making the cash forecast reliable for month close.

by_role.title: Controller
by_role.ambitious_version: Noordhaven closes on a short, known calendar, from the locked AFAS ledger, with a forecast the three sites recognise and will defend. Invoices inside the mandate go through to a Rabobank batch that a second person releases, and the controller sees the exceptions, the IBAN changes and a sample. Cash shows the next payroll, the agency peak, VAT and the holiday-allowance payout before they hit the bank. The management team gets options with a number attached, and the audit file is the close log they already signed.

by_role.title: Finance Director
by_role.ambitious_version: Close the month in five working days with a rolling 18-month forecast per site and customer that the management team uses for decisions, and correct indexation on every contract, run by a finance team that spends its time on analysis and advice.
